verdict.rationale: The SDK/API let engineering leads programmatically spin up multiple agents (agent.run()) and explicitly mention processing multiple repositories with consistent changes and triggering agents from CI/CD pipelines, implying support for concurrent agent execution at scale. However there's no explicit documentation of concurrency limits, dashboards for monitoring many simultaneous agents, or throughput-focused guarantees. Missing for 10: explicit concurrency/queue management docs, evidence of a UI/dashboard for tracking many parallel agent runs, and independent/hands-on confirmation of scaling behavior.
